held.noPurchasingRequests: Buyers create POs: ask a buyer. The line also waits in their Requests to buy.
held.noPoView: Your role cannot open purchase orders (purchasing.view).
held.lineGone: The line is not in the plan shown: run the plan again.
held.lineNotOpen: The line is in a PO already, set aside, or covered.
held.notFirm: This line has no firm planned order.
held.noFirm: Your role cannot change firm planned orders (planning.firm).
held.noBuyFix: None of the ticked rows has a line to buy.
held.noSend: Your role cannot send purchase orders (purchasing.send).
held.noneReady: No order is ready to send: fix them on their pages first.

move.title: Move the firm planned order
move.body: It brings {quantity} {unit} by {date}. Pick the day it should come; the quantity stays.
move.hint: Today or later. The next run plans around it.
move.past: Pick today or a later day.
move.same: It is on that day already.
move.changed: The line changed since it was read (a new run or a colleague): the plan was read again.
move.refused: The day or the quantity was not accepted: nothing changed.
move.failed: The firm order was not moved. Try again.

notice.moved: The firm planned order of {material} now comes {date}.
notice.sent_one: {count} purchase order sent: its supplier gets the order and the link to confirm.
notice.sent_other: {count} purchase orders sent: each supplier gets its order and the link to confirm.

menu.requests: Requests to buy (Purchasing): the same lines in the buyers’ queue

short.title: Short on open work orders
short.noFix: No fix here yet: see the line in the plan

fix.buyLabel: Buy {material} for {workOrder}: a draft PO from the plan
fix.expediteLabel: Expedite {number} for {workOrder}: open the PO and remind the supplier

short.failed: Couldn’t load short on open work orders

empty.title: No work order is waiting for material
empty.body: Every open or planned work order has its material in stock, reserved or on the way in time.

why.firm: A firm planned order brings {quantity} {unit} by {date}: the plan does not change it, and it is what is bought.
why.firmCarried: A firm planned order carried from an earlier plan brings {quantity} {unit} by {date}: the plan does not change it.
why.holdHide: This hide is on hold: {reason}, since {date}
why.holdLot: The lot is on hold: {reason}, since {date}

peg.title: For orders: what covers each
peg.none: This plan has no pegging for the line (a plan made before it was kept).

send.subtitle: Each order goes on its own: its mail, its PDF and its link to confirm.
send.mailNote: Nothing is sent before you press Send.
send.failed: The orders could not be checked or sent
send.cardRefused: This order cannot be read for sending: open it.
send.fixOnPo: Fix it on its page, then send it from there.
send.doneBody: {sent} of {count} sent; each supplier gets its own mail and link to confirm.
send.sentOne: Sent: waiting for the supplier to confirm

refused.conflict: Not sent: it changed meanwhile (open it and send it from its page)
refused.forbidden: Not sent: your role cannot send it
refused.other: Not sent: open it to see why
